title: crm/test_crm.py::test_acl_entry Fails with ""crm_stats_acl_entry_used" counter was not decremented ..." on single asic LCs
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
Full error is:
```
Failed: "crm_stats_acl_entry_used" counter was not decremented or "crm_stats_acl_entry_available" counter was not incremented
```

This regression was introduced by:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/10342

The issue is with this conditional:
```
# Check if Portchannel belongs to this namespace
if lagData['namespace'] != asichost.namespace:
    continue
```

On single asic LCs these will return non-matching values:
```
(Pdb) asichost.namespace
(Pdb) asichost
<SonicAsic 0>
(Pdb) lagData['namespace']
u''
```

So we will end up excluding the port-channels and counting an ACL entry per LAG member which returns the wrong count.

linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes #10990 

The conditional added in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/10342 doesn't work on single-asic systems:
```
(Pdb) asichost.namespace
(Pdb) asichost
<SonicAsic 0>
(Pdb) lagData['namespace']
u''
```

Skip the check on single-asic systems
